items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And on trumpet, I couldn't get Marty Marsala : he wasn't available.

ctx.x: 52nd Street. He was working there with -- and he had Buddy Rich on drums. I don't remember the other people. Oh, and we had Marty Marsala on trumpet.
